answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one meadow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 261 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 281 times the capital for one share. The copper report publishes the merge explicitly at each ledge. A farm of 3496 identities would post 1119 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
